title: Last Circle
short_description: A 50-player battle royale shooter — drop onto one of three maps, loot chests, and outlive 49 fiercely competitive opponents as the storm closes in.
description: Last Circle is a full third-person battle royale shooter in the browser. Every match is a 50-player lobby — you plus 49 AI opponents that loot, rotate with the storm, take cover, flank, and fight like real players (friends can join over the network and instantly replace a bot). Three distinct maps — the vibrant tropical Isla Viva, the shattered downtown of Ashgrid, and the deep conifer wilds of Deepwood — each with unique POIs, glowing loot chests, and high ground. Everyone drops with a pistol; fight for assault rifles, shotguns, snipers, SMGs, and grenade launchers, with shields, supply drops, real swimming, and a shrinking storm. Standard, 5-minute Quick, and Practice modes.
controls_keyboard: WASD move · Mouse aim/fire · RMB aim down sights · SPACE jump · SHIFT sprint · R reload · E loot (hold to open chests) · 1-5/scroll weapons · M map
